items.title: 4.2.5 Graph: Best for Networked Data (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a graph (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Cheezon (nodes) aur un ke darmiyan rabton (edges) ko dikhane ke liye graph istemal karein: users aur dost ya followers ke social networks, naqshon aur games mein sab se chhote raaste jaisi pathfinding, aur ek doosre par munhasir software hisson ki build tarteeb jaisi dependency resolution.

blocks.prompt: Maps app sarkon ko weighted graph kyun banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Chowk vertices, sarkein edges, aur faasle ya safar ke waqt weights hain, to app sab se chhota ya tez raasta dhoond sakti hai.
